description:
Search newly registered domains from a live feed with exact registration and expiry timestamps; names usually appear within minutes of registration. Covers generic TLDs plus these country-code TLDs: .ai, .io, .co, .si, .sh, .so, .cc, and .br, .mx, .cl, .gg, .id, .my including their second-level registrations such as .com.br and .co.id (tld 'br' returns the whole .br family; combine it with a keyword); government, military, education and non-profit categories are not included. Which country-code TLDs you can see depends on your plan; asking for one outside it returns a message saying so. The listed country-code TLDs reach back 60 days, while generic TLDs cover only the last few days, so this tool works best for the most recent three days. Use nrds instead for older generic-TLD history, for filtering by a second-level suffix such as com.br, for registration-term or for-sale filters, for the cross-TLD count, or for deeper paging.

Related tools: nrds, whois, dns, typosquat

keyword.description: Search term, 2-64 characters, letters/digits/hyphens only. Matches anywhere in the name unless position is set.

page.description: Page number for pagination. The live feed pages through the first 10000 matches; narrow the filters to reach beyond that.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match). Requires keyword.

sort.description: Sort order. Default is reg_date_desc (most recent first).

tld.description: Filter by a single TLD without dots (e.g., 'com', 'ai', 'io'). 'br', 'mx', 'cl', 'gg', 'id' or 'my' covers that country's whole family; combine it with a keyword. One TLD per call; omit to cover all TLDs.

name: nrds_live

expiry_date.description: Expiry timestamp; the gap from registered_date is the registration term

length.description: Character length of the name before the TLD

registered_date.description: Registration timestamp as supplied by the live feed

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages

title: Live Newly Registered Domains
